_comment: Accepted security-ci false positives. Each entry is scoped to a stable source ID and records its accountable owner, reason, and ledger task.

allowlist.reason: Accepted false positive (PLAT-5808; ledgers PLAT-5775 / PLAT-6123). The literal secret is a malicious HS256 negative-control fixture in test_hs256_shared_secret_token_is_rejected, which proves the production RS256/JWKS-only verifier rejects shared-secret tokens.
